feeds.title: Women Who Cycle
feeds.description: Covers articles on bike clothing, maintenance, travel, accidents, tours and more. Nicola Rutzou is a Sydney-based cyclist who is passionate about cycling and encouraging other women to join.

feeds.title: La Ridley
feeds.description: A Ridley women's cycling community where tips, tricks and pro-racing experience are shared to be practiced on your 2-wheeled bundle of joy. La Ridley women know how to Be Tough. Professional female cyclists share tips & stories on this blog.

feeds.title: Femme Cyclist
feeds.description: Blogs for women who like to bike (road cycling, mountain biking, and commuting). Femme Cyclist provides reviews, product guides, and tips and tricks to help you have more fun riding your bicycle.

feeds.title: Terry Peloton
feeds.description: Embark on a liberating two-wheeled journey with inspiration and cycling tips from Terry staff in the Terry Peloton blog - the information hub for the Terry Women's Cycling Community. Terry is a premiere woman bicycle company designing innovative bikes, saddles, apparel, and accessories that fit mobilized women and deliver smooth, comfortable experience.

feeds.title: Cyclechic Blog
feeds.description: Articles on cycling books, cycling jackets, product reviews, tips, advice and more. Cyclechic's mission is to promote cycling as a desirable lifestyle choice and encourage more women to take to two wheels. We aim to provide urban cyclists with the best range of stylish yet practical cycling accessories and The Cyclechic Blog offers tips, advice and style inspiration.

feeds.title: Team Coop Hitec Products
feeds.description: We are the small-big team of the women's peloton. Growing from the roots up Hitec Products is committed to furthering women's cycling and Norwegian women's cycling in particular.

feeds.title: MawonaVelo Blog
feeds.description: Middle-aged woman on a bike. Hi, I'm Marcia. I'm 53, a wife, a mother & a self-confessed Bikeaholic. I've had a bike for as long as I remember. When I was young, it was just what children did. We crawled, we walked, we got a bike for Christmas.

feeds.title: 2Wheel Chick
feeds.description: A Blog about a woman cyclist reflecting mostly on cycling in a whole host of forms, including the odd adventure on or off the bike!

feeds.title: Liv Vancouver Blog
feeds.description: Liv Vancouver is a small, independently owned store centrally located in Vancouver, B.C.'s hip West 4th neighbourhood. Owner Anne-Marie Gagnon loves riding bikes of all kinds and is thrilled to apply her vast experience in the industry to making cycling more accessible and enjoyable for women.

feeds.title: Edmonton Road & Track Club Blog
feeds.description: ERTC stresses learning, coaching, fair competition and safe, responsible riding. Road, MTB, Cyclocross and Track. We also deliver women's-only training and social rides that allow new and experienced riders to develop and improve fitness and riding skills.

feeds.title: Adele Mitchell » Cycling
feeds.description: I'm an award winning freelance beauty and fashion editor and copywriter, and I also write about women's cycling. I am a keen mountain biker and road cyclist and, having written a piece on women and mountain biking for Dirt, now regularly contribute to Total Women's Cycling.

feeds.title: Total Women's Cycling
feeds.description: For Women who love to Ride. Promoting Women's Cycling in the UK and abroad, with latest News, Guides and Reviews for all levels of Cycling. The UKs most popular cycling website for women.

feeds.title: A Girl and Her Bike
feeds.description: Adventures in Cycling. Mom, Cop & Everything in Between.

feeds.title: Vamper.cc » Women's Cycling
feeds.description: Vamper.cc is a cycling blog dedicated to seeking out style and performance on two wheels. We deliver product reviews, cycling tips and write-ups of our experiences on bikes in we hope! an approachable, personal way.
